column1: # Source-owned bounded integer window-value state evidence.

column5: The dependency-closed already-evaluated integer state transitions for FIRST_VALUE, LAST_VALUE, and NTH_VALUE are ported: first-row capture including NULL, last-row overwrite, one-based batch-spanning NTH selection, zero/unreached NULL, and reset; typed evaluators, all value domains, memory/chunk/window dispatch, and lifecycle remain external.
